PPSSPP v1.17.1: https://github.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/tree/d479b74ed9c3e321bc3735da29bc125a2ac3b9b2
FFmpeg fork: https://github.com/hrydgard/ppsspp-ffmpeg/tree/82049cca2e4c1516ed00a77b502a21f91b7843f4
QNX compiler port: https://github.com/luka-dev/qnx65-armv7-toolchain/tree/baa45224f18ae6b13c2e9c77c6663bb8181eb6a1
The exact QNX source edits, build flags, dependency pins and reproduction notes
are in source/native/psp in the accompanying local project. Unmodified source
trees and the complete pinned Git export remain in the private Gate3 workspace.
No proprietary BMW/QNX shared library or Sony firmware is redistributed.
Only PPSSPP's upstream free replacement fonts are packaged:
https://www.ppsspp.org/docs/getting-started/using-original-fonts/
